caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Mark H. ALLENBAUGH.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Mark H. ALLENBAUGH.

Mark H. Allenbaugh, of Conneaut, Ohio, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
